per_shot.note: Real hab shell: ribbed ceiling with fixtures, riveted wall panels, conduit, red trim, floor plating, warm ceiling pools; but walls are one beige value and the lower 40% of frame is dead dim plating.
Same solid shell, warm porthole dusk discs read well on the wall; floor shows only a suit-centred pool, no window light landing, room still reads sparse and monochrome brown.
Cork board and crates add life; lighting is pleasant but flat, east bulkhead is a near-black slab with no structure.
Fern, glowing radio, patterned woven rug and book shelf all read at play size; radio adds a warm practical; clearly richer than stock.
Best frame: arc lamp pools warm light on wall and floor, star chart glows blue as a cool accent, books read; suit remains the brightest read.
Kettle and cups, bunk with bedding and reading light, gallery doorway with sign all read; warm and lived-in, though a smeary red-violet floor wash at right reads as an artifact.

top_issues.issue: Foreground floor is a large empty, evenly dim band
top_issues.why: Roughly the bottom third of every frame is near-uniform brown plating with no light event, so the room feels like a big box despite the detailed back wall.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Bring the camera floor crop in or give the plating value variation (darker toward camera, worn sheen strips, a skirting/grate line) so the eye stays on the lit wall band.

top_issues.why: Wall, ceiling and floor all sit in the same mid-brown; the brief asks for value variation across surfaces and dark corners for contrast.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Separate the planes by value: darker ceiling between fixtures, lighter insulated wall panels inside the pools, deeper corners and bulkhead recesses.

top_issues.issue: Porthole dusk does not land on the floor
top_issues.why: Portholes glow but cast nothing on the floor, missing the brief's dusk spill and the 02-surface lit-window warmth.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Project a soft, porthole-shaped warm patch at the wall-floor junction directly below each porthole, fading out into the room.

top_issues.issue: Gallery doorway casts a smeared red-violet floor wash
top_issues.why: The tall blurry magenta streak at right reads as a render artifact rather than light from the wing.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Contain the wing's spill to a shaped pool at the threshold, or warm it into the hall palette.

top_issues.issue: East bulkhead is a black slab
top_issues.why: The brief forbids black slab surfaces; it reads as void, not hab structure.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Give it panel seams, a door frame or a dim status light wash.

protect: Ribbed ceiling with lit fixtures and conduit runs (no black-void ceiling)
Warm practical pools on the wall from ceiling lights, arc lamp and radio
Patterned woven rug, fern, glowing radio, books, kettle and cups, bunk with bedding, star chart all reading as themselves
Suit stays the most legible thing in frame
Porthole dusk discs on the wall

per_shot.note: Same shell as A plus two round orange floor discs in the foreground; they add warmth but float far from the portholes and read as stains.
Three evenly spaced saturated discs across the front floor read as spot artifacts, not window light; slightly busier than A without reading as dusk spill.
Single foreground disc breaks the dead floor a little but has no clear source.
Furnishings identical to A and read well; added discs are minor noise.
Arc lamp pool and star chart still strong; four floor discs compete with the lamp's genuine pool and muddy where light comes from.
Same as A; extra disc overlaps existing pools and is barely noticed.

top_issues.issue: Porthole spill reads as detached round blobs
top_issues.why: The discs sit in the near foreground, are circular and saturated, and do not line up with the portholes in perspective, so they read as stains or lens spots rather than dusk landing from a window.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Move the spill to the floor just in front of the wall below each porthole, stretch it toward camera as a soft elongated shape, lower saturation, and tie it to the porthole hue.

top_issues.issue: Foreground floor is still a large empty band
top_issues.why: Discs break it up but do not give it material or structure.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Add value variation and wear to the plating, or crop less floor.

top_issues.why: Wall, ceiling and floor share one mid-brown, so the stock room is flat.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Separate planes by value and deepen corners.
Contain to a shaped threshold pool.

top_issues.issue: East bulkhead is a black slab
top_issues.why: Reads as void, not hab structure.
top_issues.suggested_direction: Add seams, frame or a dim status light wash.

protect: Ribbed ceiling with lit fixtures and conduit
Warm practical pools from ceiling lights, arc lamp and radio
All furnishings reading as themselves at play size
Suit stays the most legible thing in frame
The intent to put porthole dusk on the floor, once it is shaped and placed correctly

why: The builds are identical except B's porthole floor spill, which lands as detached circular orange blobs in the foreground rather than window light, adding noise without reading as dusk; A is marginally cleaner.
